answer: An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The whisper schedule is applied in shale and canyon publishes each instalment. A payout is split and as a result 22% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2023 identities would post 813 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
